Without your help, I would have been frozen by\nBaphomela and watch the city filled with anti\nXmas energy...
Navida City and Nicola were saved.\nIt's all thanks to you. I appreciate it...
Ohhh, I feel kinda embarrassed but it's not bad.
We are not working for the caravan to receive\nthanks but I always feel happy to hear that.
